blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything , a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead.
Our approach introduces three key innovations. First , we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second , we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point’s destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third , we propose 3D WAFT , replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud.
To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video is the primary medium through which modern AI models perceive the dynamic physical world, underpinning vision-language models ( Team et al., 2025 ) , vision-language-action policies ( Intelligence et al., 2026 ) , and point trackers ( Harley et al., 2025 ) alike. Yet processing video in frame-by-frame 2D representations incurs a computational cost and memory footprint that scales linearly with video duration: each new frame introduces a full grid of visual tokens that must be processed, regardless of whether it reveals novel scene content or merely re-observes surfaces already seen. This per-frame redundancy severely limits scalability to long videos.
blocks.zh: 视频是现代AI模型感知动态物理世界的主要媒介,支撑视觉语言模型(Team等人,2025年),视觉语言行动政策(Intelligence等人,2026年),以及点追踪器(Harley等人,2025年)等. 然而在帧2D表达式中处理视频会产生计算成本和内存足迹,以视频持续时间线性地缩放:每个新帧都引入了一整套必须处理的视觉信号,无论它是否揭示了新的场景内容,还是仅仅重新观测已经看到的表面. 这种每帧冗余严重限制了长视频的可扩展性.

blocks.en: In point tracking, for example, this redundancy forces an unnatural divide. Sparse trackers ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Karaev et al., 2025 ) can track over extended time horizons, but only for a sparse set of user-specified query points, leaving the rest of the scene unmodeled. Dense trackers , in contrast, operate in frame-local pixel space where redundant re-encoding causes computation to explode with video length. Consequently, existing dense methods are forced into severe compromises: they either track only points visible in the first frame ( Harley et al., 2025 ; Ngo et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Karhade et al., 2026 ) , ignoring newly disoccluded surfaces, or track all points but remain restricted to short clips of 48–64 frames ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Sucar et al., 2026 ) . As a result, no prior method can track all visible scene points across full-length videos.
blocks.zh: 例如,在点跟踪中,这种冗余会迫使出现非自然的鸿沟. Sparse trackers (Zhang et al., 2026a; Xiao et al., 2025; Karaev et al., 2025) 可以在较长的时间范围内进行追踪,但只能为一组用户专用的查询点进行追踪,使得其余的场景没有模型化. 反之,Dense trackers在帧-局部像素空间运行,冗余的重新编码导致计算以视频长度爆炸. 因此,现有的密集方法被迫作出严重妥协:它们要么只跟踪第一帧可见的点(Harley等人,2025年;Ngo等人,2025年;Feng等人,2025年;Karhade等人,2026年),而忽略了新近失守的表面,要么跟踪所有点,但仍限于48-64帧的短片(Zhang等人,2026年b;Sucar等人,2026年)。 因此,任何先前的方法都无法在全长视频中跟踪所有可见的场景点.

blocks.en: These standard video processing regimes under-exploit the fact that videos are merely streams of 2D camera projections of an underlying 3D world. In a 3D-based scene representation, there is an opportunity to scale with unique scene content rather than video duration. Exploiting this gap between frame-based scaling and 3D scene-centric scaling is the central motivation of our work.
blocks.zh: 这些标准的视频处理制度 开发不足的事实, 视频只是流 2D 相机投影 基础 3D 世界。 在基于3D的场景表现中,有机会以独特的场景内容而非视频持续时间进行规模化. 利用基于帧的缩放和以3D场景为中心的缩放之间的这一差距,是我们工作的核心动力.

blocks.en: We introduce TrackEverything , a 3D point tracker representing videos as non-redundant and long-horizon 3D scene tracks in world coordinates ( Figure 1 ). Instead of redundantly tracking every 2D pixel across time, TrackEverything maintains a 3D representation that scales with unique physical geometry rather than frame count. Our architecture achieves this through three key innovations: First , we introduce a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at temporal window boundaries. When points from different frames converge onto the same physical surface, they occupy the same 3D coordinates and are merged into a single canonical track, preventing redundant copies from accumulating over time. Second , we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner and a trajectory refiner . The endpoint refiner estimates each point’s destination at the end of the window and classifies it as static or dynamic; the trajectory refiner then decodes dense within-window trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Because static points remain stationary in world coordinates, this factorization concentrates dense decoding on the small moving subset of the scene. Third , we propose 3D WAFT , an extension of warp-aligned feature transforms ( Wang and Deng, 2026 ) to 3D point clouds. By sampling feature maps at projected source and target locations, 3D WAFT replaces memory-intensive 4D correlation volumes with efficient template matching at a fraction of the compute cost.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍轨道 Everything,一个代表视频的3D点跟踪器,作为世界坐标中非冗余和长视距的3D场景轨道(图1). Track Everything 与其在时间上重复跟踪每个2D像素,不如维持一个以独特的物理几何而不是帧计的3D表示. 我们的架构通过三大创新来实现这一点: 首先,我们在时间窗口边界上引入了一种基于排氧的去重复机制。 当来自不同框架的点汇合到同一个物理表面时,它们占据了相同的3D坐标,并被合并成单一的舟形轨道,防止冗余副本随时间而积累. 第二,我们把追踪分解成端点精炼器和轨迹精炼器。 端点精炼器估计每个点在窗口末端的目的地,并将其分类为静态或动态;轨迹精炼器然后将密集的窗口内轨迹解码,专门用于动态点. 由于静态点在世界坐标中保持静止,这种因子化将密集的解码集中在场景的小移动子集上. 第三,我们提出3D WAFT,一个向曲的特性变换(王和邓,2026年)的延伸,到3D点云. 通过在预测的来源和目标地点取样特征图,3D WAFT用高效的模板匹配取代了内存密集的4D相关卷,成本为计算成本的一小部分.

blocks.en: Concretely, TrackEverything processes a video with a sliding window strategy. Within each window, 2D visual features are unprojected into a world-coordinate feature cloud using camera poses and depth from sensors or off-the-shelf estimators (e.g., VGGT ( Wang et al., 2026a ) ). An endpoint refiner transformer iteratively updates each point’s estimated 3D position at the end of the window using 3D WAFT feature sampling, while simultaneously predicting its static-vs.-dynamic classification. For points classified as dynamic, a trajectory refiner decodes dense within-window trajectories conditioned on their motion and local scene context, while static points trivially retain their positions. Finally, at each window boundary, the 3D feature cloud is voxelized at the updated positions to merge co-located points, yielding a compact, de-duplicated set of tracks for the next window, to be tracked alongside newly revealed content.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,轨道 一切都用滑动窗口策略处理视频. 在每个窗口内,2D视觉特征没有被预测成世界坐标特征云,使用传感器或现成估计器的相机姿势和深度(例如VGGT(Wang等人,2026a )). 一个端点精炼器变压器利用3D WAFT特征采样,迭代更新每个点在窗口端的估计3D位置,同时预测其静态-v.-动力分类. 对于被归类为动态的点,一个轨迹精炼器解码了以它们运动和局部场景背景为条件的密集的窗口内轨迹,而静态点则微不足道地保留了它们的位置. 最后,在每个窗口边界上,3D特征云在更新的位置被voxel化,以合并合用位置的点,产生一组紧凑的,为下一窗口所复制的轨迹,与新披露的内容一起跟踪.

blocks.en: We evaluate TrackEverything on standard 3D point tracking benchmarks including TAPVid-3D ( Koppula et al., 2024 ) . On short clips, where prior all-frame dense baselines remain computationally viable, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D tracking methods by more than 20% APD. Crucially, while existing all-frame dense trackers exhaust GPU memory beyond roughly 96 frames, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker that scales to tracking all points across videos exceeding 1000 frames—operating within 40 GB of GPU memory. Despite tracking orders of magnitude more points, TrackEverything remains competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers and first-frame dense methods on long sequences, while providing dense tracks for the entire scene.
blocks.zh: 我们评价轨迹 所有关于标准三维点跟踪基准,包括TAPVid-3D(Koppula等人,2024年). 在短片段上,如果先前所有帧密集基线在计算上仍然可行,那么Tack Everything的性能将所有开源所有帧密集的3D跟踪方法都超过20%的APD. 关键是,虽然现有的全帧密集跟踪器将GPU内存排出大约96帧之外, Track 每件事物都是第一个3D追踪器,它能够对超过1000帧的视频中的所有点进行追踪——运行在GPU内存的40GB范围内. 尽管追踪数量级的分数较多,但Track Everything仍然与最先进的零星追踪器和长序上第一帧密集方法有竞争力,同时为整个场景提供密集的轨道.

blocks.en: Beyond point tracking, we believe our persistent, de-duplicating 3D dynamic scene representations provide a long-sought substrate for downstream foundation models. While explicit 3D representations have shown clear benefits for vision-language models ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Jain et al., 2025 ) , robotic manipulation policies ( Ke et al., 2025 ) , and video generation ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , existing approaches remain largely confined to static or quasi-static scenes. By making all-point tracking computationally tractable over extended horizons, TrackEverything opens an exciting path toward extending these models to dynamic, real-world environments.
blocks.zh: 除了跟踪点外,我们认为,我们持久、不重复的3D动态场景展示为下游的基础模型提供了一个长期追求的基础。 虽然明确的3D表达方式显示出了视觉语言模型(Lin等人,2026年;Jain等人,2025年),机器人操纵政策(Ke等人,2025年)和视频生成(Zhou等人,2025年)的明显好处,但现有方法仍然基本局限于静态或准静态场景. 通过让全点跟踪在延长的视野上可以被计算, Track Everything开启了一条令人振奋的道路,将这些模型扩展到动态的,现实的世界环境.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce TrackEverything, which to the best of our knowledge is the first 3D point tracker capable of tracking all visible points across long horizons (1000+ frames). • We propose a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism, making our representation complexity scale with unique physical scene geometry rather than video duration. • We introduce two efficiency gains: (1) “endpoints before trajectories” as a problem decomposition, to focus dense decoding on dynamic points, and (2) 3D WAFT to replace expensive 4D correlations with efficient feature sampling, together making all-frame tracking practical. • On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, and matches state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, and is the only method that scales all-point tracking to 1000+ frames.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Sparse Point Tracking. PIPs ( Harley et al., 2022 ) and TAP-Vid ( Doersch et al., 2022 ) established the modern paradigm for sparse point tracking: tracking a small set of user defined query points across videos. Subsequent methods ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) follow the same recipe: sliding-window inference for long videos, and recurrent iterative refinement guided by 4D correlation volumes between query features and dense video features ( Teed and Deng, 2020 ) . However, constructing and querying dense correlation volumes scales with the number of query points, thus limiting the number of points that can be tracked. Recent work extends sparse tracking into 3D: SpatialTracker ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) represents points via tri-plane representations, TAPIP-3D ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) performs neighborhood attention within 3D feature clouds, and SpatialTracker-v2 ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) jointly refines geometry and motion using both 2D and 3D correlations. While these methods use 3D representations, their internal feature clouds retain a full grid of points for every video frame, causing memory to scale linearly with video duration. TrackEverything adopts the recurrent sliding-window methodology, but diverges in three respects: (1) our 3D representation is not tied to pixel space, but grows only when new scene content appears, via voxelization-based de-duplication; (2) we replace expensive 4D correlations with a cheaper 3D extension of WAFT ( Wang and Deng, 2026 ) ; and (3) we track all points across all frames of a long video, rather than being restrictedto a sparse query set.
blocks.zh: Sparse 点跟踪。 PIPs(Harley等人,2022年)和TAP-Vid(Doersch等人,2022年)建立了稀疏点追踪的现代范式:追踪一小组用户定义的跨视频的查询点. 随后的方法(Karaev 等人,2025年)遵循相同的配方:对长视频进行滑动-窗口推论,在查询功能和密集视频功能之间的4D相关卷的指导下反复进行迭代完善(Teed和Deng,2020年). 然而,构建和查询与查询点数目的密集关联量尺度,从而限制了可跟踪的点数. 最近的工作将稀疏的跟踪延伸至3D:空间跟踪器(Xiao等人,2024年)通过三平面表示代表点,TAPIP-3D(Zhang等人,2026a年)在3D特征云内进行邻里关注,空间跟踪器-v2(Xiao等人,2025年)利用2D和3D的关联性共同改进几何和运动. 这些方法虽然使用3D表示法,但其内部特征云为每个视频帧保留了完整的点数网格,导致内存随着视频持续时间的线性放大. 音轨 每件事都采用反复出现的滑窗方法,但在三个方面有所区别:(1) 我们的3D表示不与像素空间绑定,而只在新场景内容出现时,通过基于voxelization的去重复出现才会增长;(2) 我们用更便宜的WAFT的3D扩展(Wang和Deng, 2026)来取代昂贵的4D关联;(3) 我们追踪一个长视频的所有帧的所有点,而不是被限制在一个稀疏的查询集.

blocks.en:
Dense Point Tracking. Dense point tracking aims to track points sampled densely in a grid instead of user-specified sparse query points. In 2D, DELTA ( Ngo et al., 2025 ) , AllTracker ( Harley et al., 2025 ) , and CoWTracker ( Lai et al., 2026 ) track dense point grids in long videos, but are strictly limited to points visible in the first frame. Omnimotion ( Wang et al., 2023 ) can track all points across all frames, but requires 8+ hours of per-video test-time optimization.
In 3D, ST4RTrack ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , DPM ( Sucar et al., 2025 ) , and Any4D ( Karhade et al., 2026 ) use DUSt3R/VGGT-style backbones for dense tracking, but remain limited to tracking points visible in first frame and only on short clips. VDPM ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) , TraceAnything ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) aim to track all points across all frames, but remain confined to short videos as well due to the growing cost of pixel-space representations. Since the same surface is represented independently in every frame, tracking all points in a 512 × 512 512{\times}512 , 200-frame video requires on the order of 10 10 10^{10} predictions. TrackEverything represents videos within a persistent, world-coordinate 3D scene space. By continuously de-duplicating co-located points across sliding windows, our representation collapses temporal redundancy and expands only when genuinely new geometry is revealed, making all-frame dense tracking across 1000+ frame videos computationally viable.

blocks.en: Figure 2: TrackEverything architecture. TrackEverything processes videos in sliding windows of length L L . Encoding: Video frames are encoded and unprojected into a world-coordinate 3D feature cloud using depths/pointmaps from sensors or geometry predictors. Endpoint Refinement: Conditioned on source/target position embeddings and 3D WAFT feature sampling, a recurrent transformer iteratively predicts each point’s 3D offset Δ ​ 𝐱 \Delta\mathbf{x} at the target timestep, visibility, and a static/dynamic classification. Trajectory Refinement: Trajectories for dynamic points are initialized via constant-velocity interpolation and refined via within-track temporal self-attention and cross-attention from track summary tokens ( [cls] ) to the scene cloud. Output and De-duplication: At window boundaries, points arriving at identical 3D voxels are merged by mean-pooling before initializing the subsequent window, bounding representation size across long videos.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Given an RGB video 𝐈 ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 \mathbf{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} and per-frame 3D pointmaps 𝐏 ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 \mathbf{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} in world coordinates (obtained from sensors or feedforward reconstruction models such as VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) ), our goal is to track all visible scene surfaces over time.
Specifically, TrackEverything predicts dense 3D trajectories 𝐗 ∈ ℝ N × T × 3 \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times T\times 3} , visibility logits 𝐕 ∈ ℝ N × T \mathbf{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times T} , and static/dynamic logits 𝐒 ∈ ℝ N \mathbf{S}\in\mathbb{R}^{N} , for all N N unique scene points ( Figure 2 ), with support also for user-specified subpixel query points.
Standard frame-by-frame 2D tracking incurs memory and compute costs that scale linearly with video duration T T , as each new frame redundantly re-introduces previously observed surfaces.
TrackEverything resolves this bottleneck by tracking directly on persistent 3D physical entities in world coordinates across temporal windows of length L L .
Within each window, frames are encoded and unprojected into a world-coordinate feature cloud ( Section 3.1 ).
An iterative refinement process then decouples tracking into an endpoint refiner ( Section 3.2.1 ) that estimates end-of-window locations and classifies points as static or dynamic, and a trajectory refiner ( Section 3.2.2 ) that decodes dense within-window paths only for dynamic points. Crucially, TrackEverything achieves dense tracking with low inference complexity by coupling sliding-window inference with cross-window voxelization ( Section 3.3 ): rather than carrying all accumulated trajectories forward, we merge tracks that arrive at the same 3D voxel, since two physical entities cannot occupy the same position at the same time.

blocks.en: 3.1 Encoding
blocks.zh: 3.1 编码

blocks.en:
We process the video in non-overlapping windows of L = 16 L{=}16 frames.
Within each window, every frame is encoded by a frozen DINOv3-small ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) backbone followed by a trainable ViT Adapter head ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , yielding a feature map of shape ( L , H / 4 , W / 4 , D ) (L,H/4,W/4,D) with D = 384 D{=}384 .
Each frame’s feature map is reshaped into a set of H 4 × W 4 \tfrac{H}{4}{\times}\tfrac{W}{4} tokens, paired with world-coordinate 3D positions given by the corresponding entry in the pointmap (downsampled to the same resolution). Following Wang et al. (2024) , the scene geometry is normalized to a canonical scale globally in the reference frame of the first camera ( cam 0 \mathrm{cam}_{0} ).
To reduce spatial redundancy within each frame, tokens are quantized into voxels of size v v via ⌊ 𝐱 / v ⌋ \lfloor\mathbf{x}/v\rfloor , and tokens sharing a voxel index are merged via mean-pooling.
This voxelization is performed per-frame rather than across frames to avoid erroneous merges when distinct surfaces occupy the same 3D region at different times. The per-frame voxelized tokens are concatenated across all L L frames to form a space-time feature cloud of shape ( N , D ) (N,D) . We refer to these features individually as 𝐟 i \mathbf{f}_{i} . Note that until we finish processing the window ( Section 3.3 ), we retain multiple representatives of any surface observed in multiple timesteps.

blocks.en: 3.2 Iterative Refinement
blocks.zh: 3.2 惯性改进

blocks.en: Following the standard point tracking approach ( Harley et al., 2022 ; Doersch et al., 2023 ) , we begin with zero-velocity initializations, coming from either observed 3D position (for newly disoccluded points) or the previous window’s output (for tracked points), and we seek to iteratively refine these initializations into trajectories that track the scene.
blocks.zh: 遵循标准点跟踪方法(Harley等人,2022年;Doersch等人,2023年),我们从零速度初始化开始,要么来自观测到的3D位置(用于新离散点),要么来自之前的窗口输出(用于跟踪点),我们试图反复完善这些初始化,成为跟踪场景的轨迹.

blocks.en:
Directly decoding full L L -frame trajectories for every point in the dense feature cloud is computationally prohibitive and largely wasteful, as many scene points in real-world environments are stationary in world coordinates.
Furthermore, propagating tracking state across sliding windows does not require full trajectories —to hand points off to the next window and merge co-located surfaces, the model only needs to know each point’s destination at the window boundary.
blocks.zh:
由于现实世界环境中的许多场景点在世界坐标中处于静止状态,因此在计算上对密集特征云中每一点的全L-帧轨迹进行直接解码是令人望而却步的,而且在很大程度上是浪费的。
此外,跨滑动窗口的传播跟踪状态不需要完全的轨迹——将指向下一个窗口并合并位于同一位置的表面,模型只需要知道每个点在窗口边界的目的地.

blocks.en:
We therefore decouple tracking into two stages:
(1) An endpoint refiner ( Section 3.2.1 ) that runs over all active scene points to predict their 3D positions at the window boundary and classify them as static or dynamic. (2) A trajectory refiner ( Section 3.2.2 ) that decodes dense within-window paths exclusively for dynamic points.

因此,我们分为两个阶段:
(1)一个贯穿所有活动场景点的端点精炼器(第3.2.1节),以预测其在窗口边界上的3D位置,并将其归类为静态或动态. (2) 专门为动态点解码窗口内密集路径的轨迹精炼器(3.2.2节)。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Endpoint Refiner
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 终点炼油厂

blocks.en: The goal of the endpoint refiner is to iteratively update each point’s estimated 3D location at a designated target timestep t tgt t_{\mathrm{tgt}} , while predicting its visibility and classifying it as static or dynamic.

Timestep definitions. Each point is associated with a source timestep t src t_{\mathrm{src}} : the frame in which it was first observed in the current window ( t src ∈ { 0 , … , L − 1 } t_{\mathrm{src}}\in\{0,\dots,L{-}1\} ), or t src = − 1 t_{\mathrm{src}}=-1 for points carried over from prior windows.

On the final window during training, t tgt t_{\mathrm{tgt}} is sampled uniformly at random from { 0 , … , L − 1 } \{0,\dots,L{-}1\} , teaching the model to predict flow to arbitrary timesteps.

Feature construction: Before each transformer pass, we apply a 3D variant of the Warp-Aligned Feature Transform (WAFT) ( Wang and Deng, 2026 ) .
For every point, we project its current target-position estimate onto the 2D feature map of frame t tgt t_{\mathrm{tgt}} and bilinearly sample the image feature there, producing a target feature 𝐠 tgt \mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{tgt}} .
We similarly look up the source feature 𝐠 src \mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{src}} at its birth location, so that the model cannot “forget” the original appearance.
These are concatenated with the main feature 𝐟 i \mathbf{f}_{i} to form the actual transformer input: [ 𝐟 i ; 𝐠 src , i ; 𝐠 tgt , i ] [\mathbf{f}_{i};\;\mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{src},i};\;\mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{tgt},i}] .
Providing both source and target features gives the model an implicit template-matching signal: when the two features are similar, the current estimate is likely accurate; when they are dissimilar, refinement is needed. As shown by WAFT ( Wang and Deng, 2026 ) , self-attention over features constructed this way is sufficient for correspondence-finding. We note that the source feature 𝐠 src \mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{src}} only needs to be sampled once.

A small MLP head then decodes three outputs from each 𝐟 i \mathbf{f}_{i} : a 3D residual Δ ​ 𝐱 \Delta\mathbf{x} , a visibility logit v v , and a static/dynamic logit s s .
The target position is updated as 𝐱 tgt ( k ) = 𝐱 tgt ( k − 1 ) + Δ ​ 𝐱 ( k ) \mathbf{x}^{(k)}_{\mathrm{tgt}}=\mathbf{x}^{(k-1)}_{\mathrm{tgt}}+\Delta\mathbf{x}^{(k)} . The updated 𝐟 i \mathbf{f}_{i} are carried forward to the next module and the next window, but we do not backpropagate through time.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Trajectory Refiner
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 轨迹提炼机

blocks.en:
After the endpoint refiner
updates each point’s target-time position 𝐱 tgt ( k ) \mathbf{x}^{(k)}_{\mathrm{tgt}} , and static/dynamic classification logit s s , we refine the L L -frame (window-length) trajectory of each dynamic point.

更新每个点的目标时间位置 x tgt (k )\ mathbf{\(k)\ mathrm{ tgt} 和静态/动态分类 logit s, 我们精炼每个动态点的 L - 框架(窗口长度) 轨迹 。

blocks.en: Trajectory initialization: In the first iteration, each dynamic point’s trajectory is initialized by constant -velocity interpolation between its source and target positions. Otherwise, we use the previously estimated trajectory but with the t tgt t_{\mathrm{tgt}} position updated by the endpoint refiner.
blocks.zh: 轨迹初始化 : 在第一次迭代中,每个动态点的轨迹通过源与目标位置之间的恒-速度插值初始化. 否则,我们使用先前估计的轨迹,但使用端点精炼器更新的 t tgt t_{\mathrm{ tgt}} 位置。

blocks.en:
Feature construction: For each timestep along the trajectory, we concatenate three vectors: (i) the point’s feature from the transformer output, (ii) its source feature 𝐠 src \mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{src}} (sampled at the point’s birth location), and (iii) a feature bilinearly sampled from the 2D feature map at the position predicted by the constant-velocity estimate for that timestep.
We also append a [cls] token (initialized from the cloud feature) to serve as a track-level summary, yielding track features of shape ( N dyn , L + 1 , D ) (N_{\mathrm{dyn}},L{+}1,D) .
blocks.zh:
特色建筑: 每沿着轨迹走一步,我们就会产生三个向量:(一) 该点的特征来自变压器输出,(二) 其源特征 g src\mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{src}(在该点的诞生地点进行取样),以及(三) 从2D特征图上从该时序的恒速估计所预测的位置上,对一个特征进行双线性取样。
我们还附上一个[cls]符号(从云态特性初始化),作为轨迹级摘要,产生形状的轨迹特征(N dyn, L + 1, D) (N_{\mathrm{dyn}}, L{+}1, D).

blocks.en:
Attention and decoding: The decoder applies multiple layers of two alternating operations: (1) within-track temporal self-attention, which lets each point’s tokens exchange information along its own trajectory, and (2) cross-attention from the [cls] token to the full feature cloud, which injects scene context back into each track.
Tracks do not attend to one another, following PIPs ( Harley et al., 2022 ) and D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) ; this independence means we can decode a random subset of tracks during training yet decode all tracks at test time without distribution shift.
After the final attention layer, an MLP decodes a per-point per-timestep 3D flow residual and visibility logit, for each of the N dyn ⋅ L N_{\mathrm{dyn}}\cdot L tokens (discarding the [cls] token of each track).
blocks.zh:
注意和解码: 解码器采用两个交替操作的多层: (1)在轨时间自觉,让每个点的符号按照自己的轨迹交换信息; (2)从[cl]符号交叉向全特征云,将场景背景注入每个轨迹.
轨迹不互相照顾,依次为PIP(Harley等人,2022年)和D4RT(Zhang等人,2026b年) ;这种独立性意味着我们可以在训练期间解码随机子集的轨迹,但可以在测试时解码所有轨迹,而不进行分配转移.
在最后的注意层后, MLP 解码每点每时步的3D流余量和可见度登录, 每一个N dyn Q L MAThrm{ dyn {cdot L 令牌(丢弃每个音轨的[cl]令牌).

blocks.en:
The iterative refinement steps (endpoint update and trajectory update) are repeated for K K iterations within each window.
Each iteration re-samples the WAFT features at the newly updated target positions, giving the transformer progressively better evidence from the bilinear samples. Additionally, the xyz \mathrm{xyz} position embeddings to the feature cloud are updated with the most recent 3D estimates. This recurrent design is what allows the architecture to also chain predictions across sliding windows: the mechanism is identical, differing only in that the initialization comes from the previous window rather than from the previous iteration. We describe this next.
blocks.zh:
对K K 迭代在每个窗口内重复进行迭代完善步骤(端点更新和轨迹更新).
每个迭代在新更新的目标位置重新标出WAFT的特征,使变压器从双线标本中逐渐得到更好的证据. 此外,嵌入特性云的 xyz\mathrm{xyz} 位置更新为最新的 3D 估计 。 这种重复设计使得架构也能够连锁跨滑动窗口的预测:机制是相同的,只有初始化来自前一个窗口而不是前一个迭代,才有所不同. 接下来我们将描述这一点。

blocks.en: 3.3 Sliding Window Inference and De-Duplication
blocks.zh: 3.3 滑动窗口推论和减推

blocks.en: At the end of each window, we voxelize the feature cloud based on predicted target positions. Unlike the per-frame voxelization used during encoding, this operation merges points across multiple origin frames. This cross-frame merging is valid because all points are now tracked to the same target timestep; we thus leverage the rule that two entities cannot occupy the same voxel at the same time.
blocks.zh: 在每个窗口的尽头,我们根据预测的目标位置对特征云进行变色. 与编码时使用的每帧 voxelization不同,此操作将点跨多个起源框架合并. 这种跨框架合并是有效的,因为现在所有点都被跟踪到同一个目标时间步;因此,我们利用了两个实体不能同时占据同一个阴道的规则。

blocks.en: 3.4 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 3.4 执行细节

blocks.en:
We supervise the predicted target positions/trajectories with an L2 loss against 3D ground-truth. Visibility and static/dynamic classification are each supervised with cross-entropy loss.
Because our training datasets provide ground-truth tracks for only a subset of points, we compute losses only over the labelled points.
To save compute, we decode full trajectories for a subset of dynamic points at training time.
blocks.zh:
我们监督预测的目标位置/射线 3D地面真实度损失L2 可见度和静态/动力学分类均受到交叉内损的监管。
因为我们的训练数据集只提供一组分点的地面真实轨迹,我们只计算标点损失。
为了保存计算,我们在训练时间解码了一组动态点的全部轨迹.

blocks.en:
TrackEverything has 41M trainable parameters. The DINOv3-small backbone (20M) is frozen; the ViT Adapter head and all other modules are trained from scratch, except for the transformer attention layers which are initialized from the last layers of DINOv2-small ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) .
We train on 8 L40S-46GB GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 1 and a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1{\times}10^{-4} .
Training proceeds in two stages: 100k iterations on 32-frame videos, followed by 300k iterations on a mix of 32- and 64-frame videos.
Point clouds are normalized to unit norm following DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . We apply color jittering, random image/depth blur, and erase augmentations following TAPIP-3D ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Our training data consists of Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) , PointOdyssey ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , and Dynamic Replica ( Karaev et al., 2023 ) , each of which provide 3D track annotations for a sparse set of points.
blocks.zh:
追踪一切有41 M可训练参数. DINOv3-小主干(20M)是冷冻的;VIT适配器头和所有其他模块都是从零开始训练的,除了变压器注意层是从DINOv2-小的最后一个层初始化的(Oquab等人,2024年).
我们用8辆L40S-46GB GPU进行训练,每辆GPU的批量大小为1,学习率为1×10−4 1×Times}10^{-4}.
训练分两个阶段进行:在32帧视频上进行100k重复,然后在32帧和64帧视频的混合上进行300k重复.
点云在DUST3R(Wang et al., 2024)之后正常化为单位规范. 使用颜色抖动、随机图像/深度模糊, 我们的训练数据包括Kubric(Greff等人,2022年),PointOdyssey(Zheng等人,2023年),以及动态复制(Karaev等人,2023年),每个数据都为一组稀疏的点提供了3D轨迹说明.

blocks.en: In addition to dense tracking, TrackEverything can accept a set of query points specified as ( t , x , y ) (t,x,y) tuples. This is useful for tracking points at subpixel locations. Their features are obtained by bilinearly sampling the 2D feature map at the given frame and pixel coordinates. These query features are concatenated with the feature cloud and processed identically to grid-sampled points throughout the transformer and trajectory decoder, with the sole difference that they are excluded from voxelization so that they are never merged with nearby points.
blocks.zh: 除了密集的跟踪, Track Everything还可以接受一组指定为(t, x, y) (t, x,y) 的查询点. 这对子像素位置的跟踪点有用. 它们的特征是通过双线性取样在给定框架和像素坐标上的2D特征图而获得的. 这些查询特征与特征云相配合,并在整个变压器和轨迹解码器中与网格取样的点进行相同的处理,唯一的区别是它们被排除于阴道化之外,因此它们从未与附近的点合并.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate TrackEverything on standard 3D point tracking benchmarks and compare against both sparse and dense tracking baselines. Beyond benchmarking our own model, we aim to provide a comprehensive evaluation across method paradigms to elucidate the trade-offs in this space.
blocks.zh: 我们评价轨迹 所有关于标准三维点跟踪基准的资料,并与稀疏和密集的跟踪基线进行比较。 除了制定我们自己的模式的基准外,我们的目标是提供一种跨方法范式的全面评价,以阐明这一空间中的权衡。

blocks.en: 4.1 3D Point Tracking Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 三维点跟踪概览

blocks.en: Benchmark. We use the TAPVid-3D benchmark ( Koppula et al., 2024 ) , which comprises three datasets spanning diverse settings: Aria Digital Twin (ADT) ( Pan et al., 2023 ) with egocentric indoor videos ( ∼ 300 {\sim}300 frames), DriveTrack ( Balasingam et al., 2024 ) with egocentric driving videos ( 25 25 – 300 300 frames), and Panoptic Studio (PStudio) ( Joo et al., 2015 ) with multi-camera lab captures ( ∼ 150 {\sim}150 frames). Because dense 3D ground truth is infeasible to annotate for real-world dynamic scenes, TAPVid-3D annotates and evaluates on a sparse set of query points. Evaluating on these sampled points provides an unbiased indicator of tracking fidelity across the full scene, while enabling direct comparison with sparse tracking baselines that track only the queried points. Following prior work ( Karhade et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate our method and baselines on the official minival split of 50 video clips from each TAPVid-3D dataset. Where dense ground truth is available in simulation, we evaluate dense tracking on held-out splits of PointOdyssey ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) and Dynamic Replica ( Karaev et al., 2023 ) in the supplementary ( Table 3 ). We also provide extensive dense tracking visualizations on diverse real-world scenes on our project page.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们使用TAPVid-3D基准(Koppula等人,2024年),该基准包括三个数据集,涵盖不同的环境: Aria Digital Twin(ADT)(Pan等人,2023年),配有以自我为中心的室内视频(∼300 {\sim}300帧),DriveTrack(Balasingam等人,2024年)配有以自我为中心的驱动视频(25 25 – 300 300帧),Panoptic Studio(PStudio)(Joo等人,2015年)配有多镜头的实验室捕获(∼150 {\sim}150帧). 由于稠密的3D地面真伪对于真实世界动态场景的注释不可行,TAPVid-3D对一组稀少的查询点进行了注释和评价. 对这些抽样点进行评价,是跟踪整个场景的忠诚度的无偏见指标,同时能够与只跟踪被询问点的稀少跟踪基线进行直接比较。 继先前的工作(Karhade等人,2026年)之后,我们评价我们的方法和基线,即从每个TAPVid-3D数据集中以50个视频片段的官方微型华分机。 如果在模拟中可以获得密集的地面真相,我们评价在补充部分(表3)中对PointOdyssey(郑等人,2023年)和Dynamic Replica(Karaev等人,2023年)的搁置分裂进行密集跟踪。 我们还在我们的项目网页上就各种现实世界的场景提供广泛的密集跟踪可视化。

blocks.en: Metrics. We report the official APD metric ( Koppula et al., 2024 ) , which measures the fraction of predicted points within a distance threshold of the ground truth, averaged over a set of thresholds. Prior work uses two threshold conventions. APD-P (point-wise) uses depth-relative thresholds obtained by unprojecting pixel thresholds { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } \{1,2,4,8,16\} px into 3D via the camera intrinsics; this is the TAPVid-3D metric used by sparse trackers. APD-M (metric) uses fixed distance thresholds { 0.1 , 0.3 , 0.5 , 1.0 } \{0.1,0.3,0.5,1.0\} m, as adopted by several dense trackers. APD-P is typically stricter than APD-M. We report both to enable fair comparison across methods. We additionally report Average Jaccard (AJ) and Occlusion Accuracy (OA) for all methods in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告官方APD 度量标准(Koppula等人,2024年),该度量在地面真理的距离阈值范围内的预测点数的一小部分,平均值为一组阈值. 先前的工作采用两项门槛公约。 APD-P(点-点-点)使用未预测像素阈值{1,2,4,8,16}通过相机内含的1,2,4,8,16\}px进入3D得到的深度相对阈值;这是稀疏的跟踪器使用的TAPVid-3D度量. APD-M(量级)使用固定距离阈值{0.1,0.3,0.5,1.0}}\{0.1,0.3,0.5,1.0\} m,由多个密集的跟踪器采用. APD-P通常比APD-M更严格。 我们同时报告,以便公平比较各种方法。 我们还报告补充材料中所有方法的平均Jaccard(AJ)和Oclusion精确度(OA)。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against three classes of methods. (a) Sparse trackers track a user-specified set of query points: SpatialTracker-v2 ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , TAPIP-3D ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) (a 2D tracker lifted to 3D). (b) First-frame dense trackers track all points visible in the first frame but cannot track points that appear later: DeltaV2 ( Ngo et al., 2025 ) and Any4D ( Karhade et al., 2026 ) . DeltaV2 also has a sparse branch that can track user-specified query points originating in any frame, but that branch does not perform dense tracking. (c) All-frame dense trackers track all points across all frames: VDPM ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) and D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . We include D4RT’s reported numbers for reference, though we note that D4RT has no publicly available code or weights, uses ∼ 20 × {\sim}20{\times} our parameter count with private training data, and is evaluated only on 48-frame clips.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了三种方法。 (a) Sparse跟踪器跟踪用户指定的一组查询点: SpaceTracker-v2(Xiao等人,2025年),TAPIP-3D(Zhang等人,2026年a),CoTracker3(Karaev等人,2025年)(一个2D跟踪器升为3D). (b) 第一帧密集跟踪器跟踪第一帧中可见的所有点,但无法跟踪后来出现的点:DeltaV2(Ngo等人,2025年)和Any4D(Karhade等人,2026年)。 德尔塔 V2还有一个稀疏的分支,可以跟踪来自任何帧的用户指定查询点,但该分支不会进行密集的跟踪. (c)全帧密集跟踪器跟踪所有帧的所有点:VDPM(Sucar等人,2026年)和D4RT(Zhang等人,2026年b). 虽然我们注意到D4RT没有公开的代码或权重, 使用 Q 20 × × × 20 × Times ) 我们的参数用私人训练数据计算,

blocks.en: Geometry and evaluation protocol. Several baselines accept or require external 3D geometry. We provide VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) pointmaps to SpatialTracker-v2, TAPIP-3D, CoTracker3, Any4D, DeltaV2, and our model; for SpatialTracker-v2 and Any4D we also report numbers with their built-in geometry. VDPM and D4RT do not support external geometry. Prior dense trackers have only been evaluated on short clips (48 or 64 frames); we therefore report all methods on 48-frame clips and additionally report sparse trackers, DeltaV2, and TrackEverything on the full-length sequences.

blocks.en: Training data and model size. TrackEverything has 61M parameters (including a frozen 20M DINOv3-small backbone) and is trained on Kubric ( Greff et al., 2022 ) , PointOdyssey ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , and Dynamic Replica ( Karaev et al., 2023 ) . In contrast, several baselines train on significantly larger corpora: for instance, SpatialTracker-v2 trains on 17 datasets. D4RT is a 1B+ parameter model trained on orders of magnitude more public data alongside large undisclosed private datasets. A full breakdown of training datasets for all baselines is detailed in the supplementary.
blocks.zh: 培训数据和模型规模。 音轨 万物都有61M参数(包括一个冰冻的20M DINov3-小骨干),并接受过库布里克(Greff等人,2022年),PointOdyssey(郑等人,2023年)和动态复制品(Karaev等人,2023年)的培训. 相比之下,几辆基线列车运行在显著较大的星系上:例如,17个数据集的空间跟踪V2列车. D4RT是一个1B+参数模型,与大型未公开的私人数据集一起,在数量级上接受了更多公共数据的培训. 补充部分详细列出了所有基线的培训数据集的全部细目。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the full comparison. Among the all-frame dense trackers, TrackEverything outperforms VDPM by over 20% APD-P on average. D4RT reports higher numbers on 48-frame DriveTrack and PStudio clips (and trails behind on ADT), but uses ∼ 20 × {\sim}20{\times} our parameters, trains on significantly more data including private datasets, has no public code or weights, and does not track beyond 48 frames. Neither VDPM nor D4RT scales to full-length sequences (marked N/A); TrackEverything is the only all-frame dense tracker that does. Compared to first-frame dense trackers, TrackEverything is competitive with DeltaV2 using same VGGT- Ω \Omega backend: ahead on average and on ADT and slightly behind on DriveTrack and PStudio. DeltaV2 can only track dense points originating in the first frame (and sparse user-specified points from other frames), whereas TrackEverything densely tracks all points across all frames—a strictly more demanding setting. On full-length videos, TrackEverything is competitive with sparse 3D trackers despite tracking orders of magnitude more points.

blocks.en: 4.3 Complexity Analysis of Dense and Sparse Point Tracking
blocks.zh: 4.3 地心和斑点跟踪的复杂性分析

blocks.en: To understand how existing methods scale with video length and query point count, we measure accuracy (APD-M), inference latency, and peak GPU memory as we independently vary (a) input frame count and (b) query point count. All experiments run on a single L40S-46G GPU and include end-to-end inference time ( Figure 3 ). Notably, TrackEverything densely tracks all points in the video in addition to any supplied query points, whereas the sparse baselines track only the queried subset. We include similar APD-P analysis in the supplementary.
blocks.zh: 为了了解现有方法如何以视频长度和查询点计数来衡量,我们测量精度(APD-M),推论纬度,以及当我们独立地变换(a)输入帧计数和(b)查询点计数时的GPU内存峰值. 所有实验都运行在单一的L40S-46G GPU上,并包括端到端的推论时间(图3 ). 值得注意的是,轨道 除了任何提供的查询点之外,每件事物都密集跟踪视频中的所有点,而零星的基线只跟踪被询问子集。 我们在补充部分列入了类似的APD-P分析。

blocks.en: Setup. We compare against SpatialTracker-v2 (sparse 3D), CoTracker3-3D (sparse 2D lifted to 3D), and dense tracking methods DeltaV2 and Any4D. We evaluate on the PointOdyssey ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) validation set, which is one of the only datasets with long videos ( 1000 + 1000{+} frames) and fairly dense annotations ( 10 ​ k + 10\text{k}{+} points). Our method, Any4D, and SpatialTracker-v2 all include PointOdyssey in their training data; CoTracker3 and DeltaV2 do not. The focus in these experiments is mainly on latency and memory trends, and not on absolute accuracy. We report APD-M here and APD-P in the supplementary. When a method exceeds GPU memory we mark it as OOM.
blocks.zh: 设置. 我们比较SpaceTracker-v2(sparse 3D),CoTracker3-3D(sparse 2D升为3D),以及密集的跟踪方法DeltaV2和Any4D. 我们评价了PointOdyssey(郑等人,2023年)验证集,这是唯一一个有长视频(1000+1000+QQ帧)和相当密集的说明(10 k+10\text{k}{+}QQQ点)的数据集之一. 我们的方法Any4D和SpaceTracker-v2都在其训练数据中包括PointOdyssey;CoTracker3和DeltaV2没有. 这些实验的重点主要是耐久和记忆趋势,而不是绝对准确性. 我们报告APD-M在这里,APD-P在补充。 当一种方法超过GPU内存时,我们把它标记为OOM.

blocks.en: Scaling with video length. We fix the number of query points to 384 384 for methods that accept this parameter. As shown in Figure 3 a, accuracy degrades for all methods as the video grows longer, but the decline is notably steeper for Any4D, which processes all frames jointly. In terms of latency ( Figure 3 b), CoTracker3 is the fastest method, though it tracks only the 384 384 queried points whereas TrackEverything tracks every point in the video. DeltaV2-dense is the slowest, exceeding 100 s per clip at 200 frames for tracking first-frame points alone. For peak GPU memory ( Figure 3 c), TrackEverything exhibits the lowest footprint and the slowest growth rate: it remains under 30 GB even at 900 frames. Any4D exceeds memory at 96 frames, SpatialTracker-v2 and DeltaV2-dense at approximately 200 frames, DeltaV2-sparse at approximately 500 frames, and CoTracker3 at approximately 600 frames. Three design choices contribute to our efficiency: (i) a compact 3D representation that de-duplicates spatially redundant points, (ii) WAFT-based attention in place of expensive 4D correlation volumes, and (iii) a sliding-window inference scheme.
blocks.zh: 以视频长度缩放 。 我们将查询点数固定为384 384,用于接受这个参数的方法。 如图3 a所示,随着视频的延长,所有方法的精度都会下降,但Any4D的精度下降明显更为陡峭,它联合处理所有帧. 就耐久性(图3b)而言,CoTracker3是最快的方法,尽管它只跟踪384 384个查询点,而Track Everything则跟踪视频中的每一个点。 DeltaV2-dense是速度最慢的,在200帧时每片超过100s,仅用于跟踪第一帧点. 对于顶峰GPU内存(图3c),Track Everything显示的脚印和最慢的增长率最低:即使900帧,它仍然低于30GB. Any4D在96帧时超过内存,SpaceTracker-v2和DeltaV2-dense在约200帧时超过内存,DeltaV2-sparse在约500帧时超过内存,CoTracker3在约600帧时超过内存. 三种设计选择有助于提高我们的效率:(一) 紧凑的三维表示,使空间冗余点脱落,(二) 基于WAFT的注意取代昂贵的四维相关量,(三) 滑窗推论方案。

blocks.en: Scaling with number of query points. We fix the video length to 120 frames and vary the number of query points. We omit Any4D and DeltaV2-dense, as they do not accept query-point input. As shown in Figure 3 d, all methods largely maintain accuracy as the query count increases. However, their computational profiles diverge sharply. CoTracker3 and DeltaV2-sparse start with the lowest latency but surpass TrackEverything at approximately 750 points (DeltaV2-sparse) and 2,000 points (CoTracker3), as shown in Figure 3 e. SpatialTracker-v2’s latency rises steeply and exceeds memory at 1,000 points. TrackEverything maintains near-constant latency because additional query points do not incur expensive 4D correlation operations. In terms of memory ( Figure 3 f), SpatialTracker-v2 is the most demanding method, while CoTracker3 and TrackEverything both remain below 30 GB.

blocks.en: Takeaways. Existing dense trackers (Any4D, VDPM, DeltaV2-dense) do not scale to long videos in accuracy, latency, or memory. Sparse 3D trackers like SpatialTracker-v2 exhibit rapid growth in both latency and memory as either axis increases. CoTracker3 (2D sparse lifted to 3D) scales well in both dimensions but exceeds memory at approximately 600 frames and becomes slow beyond several thousand query points. TrackEverything is the only method that can densely track all points across all frames of long videos while also accepting up to 10,000 additional query points, with high accuracy, modest latency, and a GPU footprint that remains under 30 GB. Overall, TrackEverything is the first method that makes dense, long-video 3D point tracking practical on a single GPU.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
While TrackEverything enables all-frame dense 3D tracking over long videos, limitations remain. First, while voxelized de-duplication bounds memory growth with scene content, scaling to 1000+ frames where prior dense trackers fail beyond ∼ \sim 96 frames, active memory still continues to expand during perpetual open-world exploration; integrating spatial cache eviction for hour-long trajectories is a natural next step. Second, like prior 3D tracking models ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) , TrackEverything relies on external geometry. While this modularity allows sensor integration and benefits from ongoing advances in feedforward 3D reconstruction without retraining, performance remains coupled to underlying pointmap fidelity.
Third, the cross-window voxelization de-duplication mechanism merges tracks purely based on spatial proximity at temporal window boundaries. Because this merging is executed via irreversible mean-pooling, tracking errors can cause distinct physical surfaces to permanently collapse into a single canonical track that cannot be disentangled in subsequent frames. While users can already protect important points from being merged by specifying them through our non-voxelized query-point branch ( Section 3.4 ), future work to improve the de-duplication mechanism is an important direction. Finally, scaling model capacity and incorporating broader pretraining data is likely to yield further gains on complex real-world dynamics.

第三,跨窗口的voxelization脱复制机制将轨道完全基于时间窗口边界的空间距离而合并. 由于这种合并是通过不可逆的偶联实现的,跟踪错误可能导致截然不同的物理表面永久崩溃,形成一个无法在后续帧中分解的单条峡谷轨道. 虽然用户已经能够通过我们的非voxelized查询点分支(第3.4节)来保护重要点不被合并,但未来改进去重复机制的工作是一个重要的方向. 最后,扩大模型能力和纳入更广泛的培训前数据有可能在复杂的现实世界动态方面取得进一步收益。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that tracks all visible surfaces across long videos by representing them as persistent scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the principle that complexity should scale with unique physical geometry rather than frame count, TrackEverything resolves the computational bottleneck of dense tracking via three key innovations: voxelized de-duplication across sliding windows, an endpoint-then-trajectory decomposition focusing dense decoding on moving surfaces, and 3D WAFT for efficient feature sampling without costly 4D correlations. Empirically, TrackEverything is the first tracker capable of tracking all visible points across 1000+ frame sequences within 40 GB of GPU memory, outperforming open-source all-frame dense baselines on TAPVid-3D by over 20% APD while matching state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences. By making long-horizon dense 3D tracking practical, TrackEverything provides an essential foundation for extending persistent 3D world representations to dynamic environments.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了曲目 所有的一切,一个3D点追踪器,通过在世界坐标中将所有可见的表面作为持久性场景轨迹来跟踪长视频的所有可见表面. 基于复杂性应当以独特的物理几何而不是帧计数来衡量的原则,Track Everything通过三项关键创新解决了密集跟踪的计算瓶颈:跨滑动窗口的变速减重;端点当时的弹射分解,侧重于移动表面的密集解码;以及3D WAFT,用于高效的特征取样,而不涉及昂贵的4D相关。 经验,音轨 万物是第一个能够追踪GPU内存40 GB范围内1000+帧序列中所有可见点的追踪器,在TAPVid-3D上超过20%的APD上超越了开源全帧密集基线,同时匹配长序列上最先进的稀疏跟踪器. 通过使长视距密集的3D跟踪实用化,Track Everything为将持久的3D世界代表扩展到动态环境奠定了一个重要的基础.

While point de-duplication is primarily performed at sliding-window boundaries, our architecture supports an optional early-merge step ( voxelize_on_endpoints ) immediately following iteration 0 of the endpoint refiner.
Because static/dynamic classification converges within a single iteration, points classified as static that project to the same 3D spatial voxel at their predicted destinations are de-duplicated early.

VDPM initializes from a VGGT backbone and trains on Kubric, PointOdyssey, Waymo, and 2 static datasets. TAPIP-3D and DeltaV2 are trained only on Kubric. CoTracker3 is trained on Kubric and on additional 15k real-world videos. D4RT is trained on all of the above, 8 additional public datasets, and undisclosed internal datasets, with a 1B-parameter backbone and 144M-parameter decoder. Figure 5: Sliding-window tracking and cross-window de-duplication pipeline. Top row (Window i i ): A temporal window of frames is processed by TrackEverything to predict dense 3D tracks across all points.
At the final timestep of the window, the predicted 3D point locations (here 46k points) are voxelized by quantizing coordinates into spatial voxels and mean-pooling co-located tokens. This cross-frame de-duplication prunes redundant surface observations (reducing point count from 46k to 16k). Bottom row (Window i + 1 i+1 ): When the subsequent frame window arrives, its frames are lifted into a 3D point cloud using a feedforward geometry predictor (or sensor depths).
These newly observed points are concatenated with the de-duplicated points carried over from previous windows (serving as persistent 3D scene memory) to construct the active set of points to track.
TrackEverything then produces dense 3D trajectories for all points across all timesteps of Window i + 1 i+1 .
By chaining sliding-window processing with boundary de-duplication, TrackEverything tracks extended video sequences while bounding active token counts to unique physical scene geometry rather than video duration.

blocks.en: Our static/dynamic decomposition relies on a binary classifier at the endpoint stage. The classifier is designed such that edge-case misclassifications degrade gracefully. Specifically, if a truly static surface point is erroneously predicted as dynamic, it passes into the trajectory refiner. Because the trajectory refiner is trained on arbitrary 3D motions, including stationary points, it can simply predict a zero-displacement trajectory, leaving tracking accuracy unaffected at the expense of marginal extra compute for that token. Conversely, if a dynamic point is erroneously classified as static within a window, its trajectory is held stationary for that window duration; upon entering subsequent sliding windows, its motion state is re-evaluated, allowing it to resume dynamic tracking once the displacement becomes prominent.
blocks.zh: 我们的静态/动力分解依赖于端点阶段的二进制分解器. 分类器的设计使得边缘情况错误的分类被优雅地降解. 具体地说,如果一个真正静态的表面点被错误地预测为动态,它会传入轨道精炼器. 由于轨迹精炼器被训练为任意的3D运动,包括固定点,它可以简单地预测一个零移位轨迹,使跟踪精度不受影响,而牺牲了该符号的边际额外计算. 相反,如果一个动态点被错误地归类为窗口内的静态点,其轨迹则在该窗口期间保持静止状态;在进入随后的滑动窗口时,其运动状态被重新评价,一旦移动变得突出,它就可以恢复动态跟踪.

The 3D Warp-Aligned Feature Transform (3D WAFT) samples appearance evidence by projecting 3D candidate positions onto 2D feature maps. Camera extrinsics and intrinsics are either obtained from onboard sensors or estimated via feedforward geometry backbones ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
When points project outside the visible image frame during rapid camera ego-motion, coordinates are clamped within an extended image canvas [ − 2 ​ W , 2 ​ W ] × [ − 2 ​ H , 2 ​ H ] [-2W,2W]\times[-2H,2H] and bilinearly sampled using boundary-replicate padding.
Points that are occluded or remain outside the true field of view produce an appearance mismatch between the source feature 𝐠 src \mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{src}} and target sample 𝐠 tgt \mathbf{g}_{\mathrm{tgt}} , which provides an explicit signal for the transformer’s visibility head to predict low visibility logits.

To train our model across extended sequences without running out of GPU memory, we avoid backpropagating through time across sliding windows while still allowing the 2D visual encoder (the ViT Adapter) to receive supervisory signal across the entire video.
Specifically, 2D feature maps 𝐅 = ℰ ⁡ ( 𝐈 ) \mathbf{F}=\mathcal{E}(\mathbf{I}) are extracted across the sequence and wrapped in a detached leaf tensor 𝐅 param \mathbf{F}_{\mathrm{param}} with gradients enabled.
During sliding-window execution, forward and backward passes are evaluated window-by-window with recurrent state detached at window boundaries.
Within each window, the combined loss: ℒ = ℒ coord + λ vis ​ ℒ vis + λ dyn ​ ℒ dyn + λ conf ​ ℒ conf \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coord}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{vis}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vis}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{dyn}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dyn}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{conf}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{conf}} (4) is computed, and a local backward pass immediately accumulates gradients into the parameter gradient buffer 𝐅 param . grad \mathbf{F}_{\mathrm{param}}.\mathrm{grad} and the tracker modules.
This releases intermediate activations after each window.
Once all windows have completed, a single backward pass is executed through the 2D visual backbone via the scalar inner product ⟨ 𝐅 param . grad , 𝐅 ⟩ \langle\mathbf{F}_{\mathrm{param}}.\mathrm{grad},\mathbf{F}\rangle , propagating the accumulated visual gradients into the trainable ViT Adapter head in a single step before calling optimizer.step() .

blocks.en: Fair comparisons. Reproducing sparse baselines on TAPVid-3D has proven difficult due to the lack of standardized evaluation code. Some prior dense 3D tracking papers ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) do not compare against sparse trackers at all. We carefully re-evaluate all baselines under a unified protocol and find, for example, that SpatialTracker-v2 ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) achieves over 20% higher APD-M than what prior work ( Karhade et al., 2026 ) reports for it on TAPVid-3D.
blocks.zh: 公平比较。 事实证明,由于缺乏标准化的评价代码,在TAPVid-3D上生成的零星基线十分困难。 一些先前密集的3D跟踪文件(Sucar等人,2026年)与稀疏的跟踪器根本没有比较. 我们仔细地重新评估了统一协议下的所有基线,并发现,例如,SpaceTracker-v2(Xiao等人,2025年)的APD-M比以前的工作(Karhade等人,2026年)在TAPVid-3D上的报告高出20%以上。

blocks.en: A.5 Fixes to the PointOdyssey Dataset
blocks.zh: A.5 修复 PointOdyssey 数据集

blocks.en: During our training runs, we observed significant loss spikes, which we could trace back to the PointOdyssey dataset. We identified several critical annotation errors and developed a programmatic correction pipeline: 1. Off-by-One Camera Extrinsics: Across 16 sequences (about 25k frames), the recorded extrinsic 𝐓 t \mathbf{T}_{t} is the pose that rendered frame t − 1 t-1 , while the 3D tracks are indexed correctly. We reindex the camera to frame t + 1 t+1 and recompute the 2D tracks from that pose. The shift is a few pixels when the camera is slow and exceeds 600 ​ px 600\,\mathrm{px} during fast pans (up to 59 ∘ / frame 59^{\circ}/\mathrm{frame} ). 2. Corrupted Visibility Flags: Visibility was computed from the uncorrected pose, so the stored flags are wrong where the two poses disagree. We do not rewrite them. Point supervision is dropped on the 502 frames where the repair moves tracks by at least 8 ​ px 8\,\mathrm{px} ( 2 % 2\% of the affected sequences; at most 3.8 % 3.8\% of any one sequence). The images stay in the clip, and the camera reindexing above still supervises the remaining frames. 3. Temporally Incoherent Sequences: The sequence scene_recording_20210910_S05_S06_0_ego1 exhibits sub-frame camera jitter that cannot be resolved by an integer frame shift; we exclude it from training and evaluation splits. We also briefly explored using object segmentation masks to remove wrong point track labels by using the fact that a point born within the segmentation mask of an object should always stay within the mask. However, we found that the segmentation mask had bugs too, which makes this approach infeasible.
blocks.zh: 在我们的训练中,我们观察到重大的损失猛增,我们可以追溯到PointOdyssey数据集。 我们查明了若干关键的注释错误,并开发了一个方案纠正程序: 1. Off-by-One Camera Extrinsics:横跨16个序列(约25k帧),所记录的外部T t \ mathbf{T}_{t}是使帧t−1t−1的姿势,而3D轨迹的索引正确. 我们重新索引相机 以框架 t + 1 t + 1 并重新计算 2D 轨迹 从该姿势。 当相机缓慢且超过600 px 600\,\mathrm{px}在快锅时(最高59 ∘ / 帧 59^{\circ}/\mathrm{frame}),转动是几像素. 2. 腐败可见度 旗帜:可见度是从未校正的姿势计算出来的,因此,存储的旗帜在两种姿势有分歧的地方是错误的. 我们不改写它们。 在502帧上投放点监督, 修复时将轨道移动至少 8 px 8\,\ mathrm{px} (受影响序列的2% 2%; 最多3. 8% 任何序列的3. 8% )。 图像留在剪辑中,上面的摄像头重新索引仍然监督剩下的帧. 3. 暂时不一致的顺序: 序列场景_录制_20210910_S05_S06_0_ego1 显示子帧相机的jitter 无法通过整数帧移位解决;我们将其排除在训练和评价分裂之外. 我们还简要地探索了使用物体分解口罩去除错误的点轨标签,方法是利用一个物体分解口罩内诞生的点应始终留在口罩内这一事实. 然而,我们发现分化面具也有虫子,这使得这种方法不可行.
